AC-7 Store integrity: amendments of missing records, markers, or another profile/kind are refused before writing (file unchanged); on replay they are skipped with a warning
AC-8 Use cases: correct / entered in error / delete append exactly one record each (append-only), only on the current version (TARGET_NOT_CURRENT / TARGET_NOT_FOUND), and survive a restart
